name: Vocaloid Date
source: Oh no! Kaito has only just noticed that he is broke, hasn't got a girl friend and is having no luck, when you happen to turn up! This is my first successful visual novel, I did not make any art, I just edited art I found on images into pngs suitable for this game. The story and scripts are all made by myself and I managed to complete this in one day of solid work. Enjoy!
translation: 糟糕！KAITO刚刚才发现自己身无分文、没有女朋友，运气也差到极点，而你恰好在这时出现！这是我第一部成功完成的视觉小说。画面并非原创，我只是把网上找到的图片编辑成适用于游戏的PNG；故事和脚本则全部由我创作，花一整天连续工作便做完了。请尽情游玩！
